title: Date separators
summary: A centred day label between messages of different days, and the start-of-chat line. The SDK places them as virtual timeline items.

label.description: bipe_app_date_today, bipe_app_date_yesterday, the weekday for the last 7 days, else the date from the system formatter in the app language (13 de outubro; with the year when it is not this year).

kind.description: VirtualTimelineItem: DateDivider shows the label; ReadMarker shows bipe_app_unread_marker once; TimelineStart shows bipe_app_timeline_start.

render.effect: For each TimelineItem.asVirtual, draws the line for its kind. The label of a date divider updates at midnight.

notes: The label sticks to the top while the day's messages scroll.
Dates follow linguagem.md: day before month, never the month first.
